update.title: Separated Work Report creation from evidence curation
update.summary: Reduced report creation to one direct operation and separated evidence review into a second curation step driven by completed tool operations.

blocks.body:
## Create the factual record directly

A single create operation writes the report’s required context as a complete record. The caller supplies the narrative and report facts together, without maintaining a server-side wizard session across several responses.

Evidence remains a separate decision, so recording what happened does not depend on choosing every supporting artifact at the same time.

blocks.code:
flowchart LR
  Facts[Report facts] --> Create[Create report]
  Create --> Record[Complete record]
  Operations[Completed tool operations] --> Registry[Handler registry]
  Registry --> Candidates[Evidence candidates]
  Candidates --> Curate[Review and attach]
  Curate --> Record
blocks.description: The report is created directly; evidence reaches it through a separate, traceable curation path.

blocks.body:
## Discover evidence from completed operations

Successful tool operations form the source of evidence candidates. A declarative handler registry maps each operation type to the artifact it can produce, so discovery starts from a recorded result instead of creating records while merely inspecting files.

Curation reviews the bounded candidate set and attaches selected material to the report. Detach keeps that choice reversible without reopening a guided flow.
